Before

 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Pradeep Singh Chouhan - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri S.K. Gupta - P.L. for the respondent/State.
 Shri P.N. Sahu - Advocate for the respondent/objector.
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023/439 of the Cr.P.C.,
1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.527/2023, dated 01.08.2023, registered at Police Station- Mada, District - Singrauli (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 450, 363, 365, 366, 366(A),
376(1), 376-D of IPC and Section 4, 5(g)/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 02.08.2023.
2 .
As per the prosecution story, on 31.07.2023, 16 years old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing alleging that on 29.07.2023, she was alone in the house.
In the night of 29.07.2023, at around 11:00 P.M., someone knocked at her door.
When she opened the door, she saw Shivam and Govin of Village Churwahi with two other persons who are unknown to her.
Shivam gagged her mouth and they all forcibly took her in Khairahi forest where Shivam committed rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault
NEUTRAL
CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6184 2 MCRC-48161-2024 upon her.
Govin was also standing there.
Two other persons were also guarding them.
On 30.07.2023 Shivam and Govin took her at Shivam's maternal uncle home and she was brought from there to her home.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
No such incident had happened.
A false and frivolous FIR has been lodged.
It is further submitted that DNA report has been received and same is negative as no male profile has been found on the vaginal slide of the prosecutrix.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. DNA report has been received and same is negative.

Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023)439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Shivam Saket be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6184 3 MCRC-48161-2024 of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973 [Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023].
7 . This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
